items.question: How is TikTok advertising different from Meta & Instagram?
items.answer: TikTok is an interest-based, entertainment-first engine where native, authentic creative outperforms polished corporate ads. Our campaigns leverage TikTok-specific trends, hooks, and sound design to achieve superior engagement and lower CPA.

items.question: What is the recommended monthly ad budget to start?
items.answer: We typically work with brands ready to invest at least £2,500 to £5,000 per month in ad spend to allow sufficient statistical significance during rapid creative testing.

items.question: Do you handle all creator sourcing and video editing?
items.answer: Yes. We manage the end-to-end process: creator sourcing, briefing, scriptwriting, filming direction, dynamic subtitles, audio licensing, and high-velocity iteration.

items.question: How quickly can we launch our first campaign?
items.answer: From onboarding to campaign launch usually takes between 7 to 10 working days, including initial creative scripting and creator matching.

items.question: How do you track conversions and measure ROAS?
items.answer: We install the TikTok Pixel alongside server-side Events API (CAPI) and third-party attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam) to provide 100% transparent real-time reporting.

items.question: Can you collaborate with our in-house creative team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We often act as the dedicated TikTok growth wing, providing creative strategy, hooks, and performance media buying while collaborating closely with in-house designers.
